rationale: No supported optimization fits this workflow safely. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT's evidenced change adds timeout-minutes: 5, but CI history shows successful runs consistently take about 7-8.5 minutes, so a 5-minute limit would cause false timeouts - the pattern's own contraindication (valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit) is triggered, and no evidence supports a specific larger non-binding timeout for this workload. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is moot because the matrix has a single docker_image element, so canceling remaining matrix jobs saves nothing. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because the workflow also triggers on release (release/deployment work). Path filtering (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER) risks reducing required-check coverage, and dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) is only modestly beneficial and complicated by the ephemeral Docker container. Preserving intended build/test coverage, no minimal coverage-preserving change is supported.
